items.title: Splitting of spherical-twist symplectic monodromy for Calabi-Yau threefolds from marked bordered surfaces
items.author: Ailsa Keating; Ivan Smith; Michael Wemyss
items.source_version: Official SIGMA22(2026),080; publisher native TeX retrieved2026-10-13; arXiv2601.20438
items.difficulty_reason: The proof classifies Lagrangian spheres up to quasi-isomorphism via matching paths, distinguishes Floer-rank-two configurations, and shows compactly supported symplectomorphisms preserve the distinguished stability component. It then compares the cluster and Rabinowitz categories to annihilate the mapping-class obstruction and obtain a splitting. Unlike the disc/Milnor case, the author cannot assume connectedness of the full stability space, and supplies a separate geometric argument.
